subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

What are you being disturbed by?
solution: The correct answer is **'What is disturbing you?'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is an example of Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. • The process of transformation is as follows: • In 'active-passive' transformation except for (who and whom) rest of the Wh-family Pronouns will remain unchanged. • **'are being disturbed**' will be changed into **'is disturbing'.** • Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**. **Correct Sentence:__** *What is disturbing you?* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य** Passive Voice** का उदाहरण है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे **Active Voice** में बदलना है। • परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है: • **'active-passive' **परिवर्तन में **(who and whom)** को छोड़कर शेष **Wh-** परिवार **pronouns** अपरिवर्तित रहते हैं। • **'are being disturbed'** को **'is disturbing' **में बदल दिया जाएगा। • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3 **है। ba:Tcd0, The erroneous spelling is '**increament**'.
